questions.question: If sin θ + tan θ = p and tan θ - sin θ = q, then which of the relation satisfies for given values of p and q?
questions.solution:
**Given**

sin θ + tan θ = p

tan θ - sin θ = q

**Calculation**

sin θ + tan θ = p ..(1)

tan θ - sin θ = q ...(2)

Squaring and subtracting eq 2 from eq 1.

⇒ p 2 - q 2 = sin 2 θ + tan 2 θ + 2sin θ tan θ - (sin2 θ + tan2 θ - 2sin θ tan θ)

⇒ p2 - q2 = 4sin θ tan θ

4sin θ tan θ = 4√( sin2 θ tan2 θ)

= 4√( sin2 θ (sec2 θ - 1)

= 4√( sin2 θ/ cos2 θ - sin2 θ)

= 4√( tan2 θ - sin2 θ)

= 4√pq

Hence, p2 - q2 = 4√pq

**∴ Option 1 is the correct answer.**

questions.question: A fruit seller buys 480 bananas for Rs. 1,200. Some of these bananas are rotten and hence, they are thrown away. He sells the remaining bananas at Rs. 3.5 each and makes a profit of Rs. 396. What is the percentage of bananas thrown away?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Total Revenue** = Cost Price + Profit = 1,200 + 396 = 1,596.

**Bananas Sold** = Total Revenue ÷ Price per banana = 1,596 ÷ 3.5 = 456.

**Bananas Thrown** = Total Bananas − Bananas Sold = 480 − 456 = 24.

**Percentage Thrown** = (24 ÷ 480) × 100 = 5%.

**∴ The correct answer is 5%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given: **Cost Price (CP)** = Rs. 1,200, **Profit** = Rs. 396, **Selling Price (SP)** per banana = Rs. 3.5, **Total Bananas** = 480.

Formulas: SP = CP + Profit | Number of units = Total SP ÷ Rate per unit | Percentage = (Value ÷ Total) × 100.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4be45db805c93f1492b29aee6356c3e9a84ae3b34d915dc0ccce517c84bd0bad.png] 

⇒ Total **Selling Price (SP)** = 1,200 + 396 = Rs. 1,596.

⇒ Number of **good bananas** sold = 1,596 ÷ 3.5 = 456.

⇒ Number of **rotten bananas** thrown away = 480 − 456 = 24.

⇒ Percentage of bananas thrown away = (24 ÷ 480) × 100.

⇒ Percentage = (1 ÷ 20) × 100 = 5%.

**∴ The correct answer is 5%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Profit and Loss Basics

Profit occurs when the Selling Price (SP) is greater than the Cost Price (CP). Formula: Profit = SP − CP.

Percentage Calculation

To find what percent X is of Y, use the formula: (X ÷ Y) × 100. In this case, X is the number of rotten bananas and Y is the initial quantity.</p

questions.question: If θ is an acute angle and sin θ = (21)/(25), then what is the value of tan θ?
questions.solution:
Given

sin θ = 21/25

Formula used:

tan θ = P/B

sin θ = P/H

P² + B² = H²

Calculation

From the above-mentioned formula:

sin θ = 21/25 = P/H

⇒ 212 + B2 = 252

⇒ B2 = 252 - 212

⇒ B2 = 625 - 441

⇒ B2 = 184

⇒ B = 2√ 46

tan θ = P/B = 21/2√46

The value is **21/2√46**.

A = P + (P × R × T)/100

According to the question,

1440 = [(P × 18 × 9)/100] - [(P × 15 × 6)/100]

questions.question: The remainder of the term 9 + 9² +..+ 9⁽²ⁿ⁺¹⁾ when divided by 6 is:
questions.solution:
Given:

9 + 92 +..+ 9(2n+1)

Concept used:

When any odd multiple of 3 is divided by 6, it will leave a remainder of 3.

Calculations:

When any odd multiple of 3 is divided by 6, it will leave a remainder of 3. For e.g when 9 an odd multiple of 3 is divided by 6, you will get a remainder of 3.

9 is an odd multiple of 3. And all powers of 9 are odd multiples of 3.

Therefore, when each of the 8 powers of 9 listed above is divided by 6, each of them will leave a remainder of 3.

**The answer is 3.**

questions.question: A metallic sphere of radius 21 cm is melted and then recast into smaller cones each with a radius of 7 cm, and a height of 3 cm. Find the number of cones obtained.
questions.solution:
Given:

Metallic sphere of radius 21 cm

The radius and height are 7 cm and 3 cm

Formula used:

The volume of sphere = 4/3 × π × (r)3

Volume of one cone = 1/3 × π × (r)2 × h

Calculation:

The volume of sphere = 4/3 × π × (21)3

Volume of one cone = 1/3 × π × (7)2 × 3

The number of cones obtained = (4/3 × π × (21)3)/(1/3 × π × (7)2 × 3)

= 4 × 3 × 21

= 252

**The answer is 252.**

questions.question: An item was sold at Rs. 5,474 after two successive discounts of 12.5% and 8% were offered on its Marked Price. What was the Marked Price (in Rs.) of the item?
questions.solution:
GIVEN:

The selling price is Rs 5474

Successive discounts are 12.5% and 8%

FORMULA USED:

S.P. = (1 - d1/100 ) × ( 1- d2/100) × M.P.

Where, S.P. = Selling price , M.P. = Marked price ,

d1 and d2 are successive discount percent respectively 

CALCULATION:

We know that,

S.P. = ( 1- d1/100 ) × ( 1- d2/100) × M.P. 

⇒ 5474 = ( 1- 12.5/100 ) × ( 1 - 8/100) × M.P. 

⇒ 5474 = 7/8 × 23/25 × M.P. 

⇒ M.P = 8 × 25 × 34 

⇒ M.P. = 6800

Hence, the Marked Price of an article is Rs 6800.

questions.question: Two jars A and B are containing the solutions of two liquids P and Q. The ratio of the liquids P and Q in the jars A and B are 2 ∶ 19 and 1 ∶ 11, respectively. If 7 litres of the solution of jar A and 4 litres of the solution of jar B are mixed, what is the ratio of the solutions P and Q in the new mixture?
questions.solution:
Given 

The ratio of liquids P and Q in jars A and B are 2 ∶ 19 and 1 ∶ 11, respectively

7 litres of the solution of jar A and 4 litres of the solution of jar B are mixed

Concept used

If some mixture is taken out, it's drawn in the same initial ratio.

Calculation 

When 7 litres of mixture is taken out from jar A:

P = 7 × 2/21 and Q = 7 × 19/21

When 4 litres of mixture is taken out from jar B:

P = 4 × 1/12 and Q = 4 × 11/12

Adding the withdrawn mixture we get,

P = 7 × 2/21 + 4 × 1/12 

= 2/3 + 1/3 = 1

and Q = 7 × 19/21 + 4 × 11/12

= 19/3 + 11/3 = 30/3 = 10

P = 1 and Q = 10

**The ratio of the solutions P and Q in the new mixture is 1:10**

questions.question: A chord is drawn in a circle of radius 10 cm, if the distance of the chord from the centre is 6 cm, then the length of the chord (in cm) is:
questions.solution:
Given:

The distance of the chord from the centre = 6 cm

Radius OA = 10 cm

Concepts used:

Perpendicular drawn from the centre of the circle to the chord, bisects the chord.

Calculation:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ef5c1fedadc46c06e74cc893f47b0bbd3163afeefd87c6174cd3c17d3b397fc1.png] 

AC = AB/2 ….(⊥ drawn from the centre of the circle, bisects the chord)

Using Pythagorean Theorem,

OA² = OC² + AC²

⇒ 10² = 6² + AC²

⇒ 100 - 36 = AC²

⇒ AC² = 64

⇒ AC = 8 cm

AB = AC × 2 = 16

∴ The length of the chord from centre is 16 cm.

questions.question: Three persons A, B and C invested some money in a business. The share of A is twice the share of B, and the share of B is thrice the share of C. After 1 year, they earned Rs. 6,000. Find the money A received.
questions.solution:
Given:

A's share = 2 of B's share

B's share = 3 of C's share

Total profit = Rs. 6000

Concept used:

Profit will be directly proportional to amount invested if time period is same

Calculation:

Let the share of C be x.

Then, share of B = 3x and share of A = 6x

Total profit = x + 3x + 6x = 6000

10x = 6000

x = 600

∴ A has received rs 3600.

questions.question: If ax + by = 1 and bx + ay = (2ab)/(a²+b²), then the value of x (in terms of a and b) is:
questions.solution:
**Calculation**

ax + by = 1 -----------(1)

bx + ay = 2ab/(a²+ b²) ------------(2)

On dividing eq (1)/(2) we get,

⇒ (ax + by)/(bx + ay) = (a² + b²)/2ab

⇒ 2a²xb + 2ab²y = a²bx + b³x + a³y + ab²y

⇒ a²xb + ab²y = b³x + a³y

⇒ a²bx - b³x = a³y - ab²y

⇒ x(a²b - b³) = y(a³ - ab²)

⇒ x/y = (a³ - ab²)/(a²b - b³)

⇒ x/y = a(a² - b²)/b(a² - b²)

x/y =a/b -----------(3)

Now putting value of x and y from eq (3) in eq (1) we get,

x = a/(a² + b²)

**The answer is a/(a2 + b2).**

questions.question: After allowing a discount of 12.5% on the marked price, an article is sold for Rs. 2,625. Find its marked price.
questions.solution:
Given:

The selling price = Rs. 2625

Discount = 12.5%

Formula used:

S.P. = (100 - Discount%)/100 × M.P.

Where, S.P. = Selling price; M.P. = Marked price

Calculation:

The marked price of the article = 100/(100 - 12.5) × 2625

= 8/7 × 2625

= 8 × 375

= 3000

∴ The marked price is 3000.
